verdict.rationale: The evidence shows experimental <Suspense> support for async setup() components, plus SSR streaming and lazy hydration APIs. None of it documents a server-component model where async components fetch data on the server and pass it to separate interactive client components. These are adjacent SSR and async building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch data in asynchronous server-rendered components and pass it down to interactive client components
